bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Continuous structural load paths transfer dead, live, wind, and seismic forces from roof decking down to foundation footings.
core_mechanism_bullets: Continuous structural load paths transfer dead, live, wind, and seismic forces from roof decking down to foundation footings.
Beams experience top-fiber compression and bottom-fiber tension, whereas masonry arches channel load into pure compression.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Under the International Building Code, residential sleeping floors must support a minimum uniform live load of 30 pounds per square foot.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Load a flat foam beam marked with vertical grid lines to show top compression and bottom tension, then compare against a triangulated truss.
bespoke_clusters.real_world_connection_box: AIA Structural Load Path and Force Vector Standard: Continuous structural load paths transfer dead, live, wind, and seismic forces from roof decking down to foundation footings. Beams experience top-fiber compression and bottom-fiber tension, whereas masonry arches channel load into pure compression.

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: In the Northern Hemisphere, orienting glazing within 15 degrees of true south maximizes winter solar heat gain.
core_mechanism_bullets: In the Northern Hemisphere, orienting glazing within 15 degrees of true south maximizes winter solar heat gain.
Roof overhang projection adapts to seasonal sun altitude, which shifts by 47 degrees between summer and winter solstices.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: At 40 degrees North latitude, the noon sun reaches 73.5 degrees altitude in June (blocked by eaves) and 26.5 degrees in December (warming thermal floors).
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Use a flashlight and protractor at 26.5 degrees and 73.5 degrees angles on a cardboard house model to show winter passive heating and summer shading.
bespoke_clusters.real_world_connection_box: ASHRAE 90.1 Passive Solar and Building Envelope Standard: In the Northern Hemisphere, orienting glazing within 15 degrees of true south maximizes winter solar heat gain. Roof overhang projection adapts to seasonal sun altitude, which shifts by 47 degrees between summer and winter solstices.

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Residential floor plans commonly draft at 1/4 inch equals 1 foot-0 inches (1 to 48 ratio) on an architect's triangular scale.
core_mechanism_bullets: Residential floor plans commonly draft at 1/4 inch equals 1 foot-0 inches (1 to 48 ratio) on an architect's triangular scale.
Orthographic floor plans slice horizontally 4 feet above the finished floor to show wall thickness, window sills, and door swings.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: On a 1/4-inch architectural scale drawing, a 16-foot by 20-foot troop meeting room measures exactly 4 inches by 5 inches on paper.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Use a three-sided architect's scale rule and graph paper to measure and draw a 12-foot wall with a 3-foot inward-swinging door at 1/4-inch scale.
